title: 15 markdown skills (methodology: TDD, debugging, plans...)
notes: Strict name+description frontmatter. Upstream install routes are per-harness plugin marketplaces; the Claude-Code-only part is a SessionStart hook injecting the using-superpowers bootstrap skill — in YAAH the equivalent is the model loading it from the description index (or a future session-start auto-load toggle). Two skills assume subagent dispatch but ship written inline fallbacks. TDD/git skills assume a shell tool, which YAAH has.

title: 6 markdown-only skills (lazy-senior-dev style)
notes: name/description/argument-hint/license frontmatter. Always-on activation upstream is hook-driven; the skill still works when invoked (/s ponytail). Its description is a YAML block scalar (description: >) — parses with PyYAML (shipped), mangled only under a no-PyYAML flat fallback; worth a comment in a vendored copy.

title: 1 pure-prose output-style skill
notes: Frontmatter includes disable-model-invocation: true — exactly YAAH's own field, honored today. Plugin/npm/manual-copy install routes; manual copy works immediately.

title: 1 pure-prose style skill (+ 9 wrapper skills driving a proxy CLI)
notes: Install the one skill, skip the wrappers (they drive an external proxy CLI). npx skills add, plugin, or install.sh routes; manual copy works.

title: 166 skills: SKILL.md + references/ + Python scripts/ + assets/
notes: Strict closed-set frontmatter. Drop-in; scripts need a Python environment at runtime — surface, don't provision. Description index stays cheap (name + one-liner); bodies load on invocation.

title: 1 skill: SKILL.md + ~30 references/ + stdlib-Python scripts/ + HTML assets/
notes: Manual symlink is a documented install route. Progressive disclosure works in YAAH because the skill's folder path is handed to the model.

title: Markdown playbook driving a Python CLI (uv tool install graphifyy)
notes: Works if the user installs its CLI. The body's subagent-orchestration step would mislead YAAH's model; upstream has a sequential fallback for agents without subagents. references/ sidecars work — YAAH hands the model the folder path.

title: 1 skill backed by a 184 KB Python engine; SKILL.md body ~258 KB
notes: Installs fine but the body blows past YAAH's 60k-char cap -> silently truncated instruction contract; the manager must warn on body size. allowed-tools documents the harness tools it assumes (YAAH maps well); 15+ optional API-key env vars are the user's job.

title: Registry of 2,406 curated skills + Node 22 CLI + MCP control plane
notes: B as a source, A per individual skill. Strongest evidence curation-at-scale is solved elsewhere (per-skill risk taxonomy, per-target compatibility JSON). Full-repo installs exhaust context on other hosts — subsets only. Good browse-tab source; nothing to integrate at runtime.

title: 9 skills orchestrating 10 subagent definitions + pnpm/TypeScript core + local dashboard
notes: Harness-coupled: needs subagent orchestration (up to 7 concurrent), a pnpm build, $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT resolution, and a dashboard server. No install path works in YAAH; using it is a port, not an install. The manager must be able to say 'no' convincingly.
